item.title: Introduction to analogue photography workshop results
item.description:
Results from the latest introduction workshop. The students worked with a Rolleiflex f/3.5 and Fomapan 100 — and developed the roll during the same session.

There is something very concrete about seeing for the first time how an image appears on negatives you exposed yourself.
